title: Germany's FM Wadephul meets Lavrov on UNGA sidelines
summary: It's the first such meeting since Russia launched the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. DW has the latest.
byline: Wesley Dockery, Mark Hallam, Felix Tamsut, Jon Shelton

image.caption: Russian-German ties have been extremely strained since Russia launched its invasion of Ukraine in 2022Image: Michael Kappeler/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: German FM Wadephul meets Russia's Lavrov during UN assembly

blocks.caption: It's the first bilateral meeting between Russian and German sides since Russia launched its invasion of Ukraine in February 2022  Image: Michael Kappeler/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul is meeting his Russian counterpart Sergey Lavrov at the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.
A correspondent for the Russian Interfax news agency reported Wadephul and Lavrov, followed by aides, shaking hands before the press was asked to leave.
Russian ​Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria ​Zakharova said the meeting is taking place at the German initiative.

Moscow has been sanctioned by the EU over its full-scale invasion of Ukraine which the Kremlin launched in February 2022. The last meeting between on this level was held in January of that year, between veteran diplomat Lavrov and Germany's then-top diplomat, Annalena Baerbock, who was on a visit to Moscow.
